meaning.The Bargain Hunter: price or value for money is most important when choosing food
meaning.The Ethical Consumer: ethics, eco-friendliness or farming methods are most important
meaning.The Impulse Buyer: bought on impulse because of a promotion in the last two weeks
meaning.The Methodical Perfectionist: checks ingredients and nutrition information always or most of the time
meaning.The Humanistic Connector: trust in the supplier is most important
meaning.The Digital-First Shopper: has ordered food through a delivery app
meaning.The Tech Innovator: has used a food-sharing app such as Too Good To Go
meaning.The Trend Follower: has ordered food through social media
meaning.The Skeptical Critic: not confident in the food supply chain
meaning.The Community Advocate: started buying locally produced food in the last year

note: deprivation quintile is the neighbourhood's rank within London on income deprivation, used against the survey's national quintile
